excerpt: It integrates for two. That's how many protons are being involved.

reviewedMappings.2015-3-17:0: Yale lecturer explicitly analyzes ethyl acetate: two 3H groups, one2H group; ethyl methyl triplet from two adjacent H and OCH2 quartet from three adjacent H; integration vs multiplicity distinction. Original plot supplies ~4,2,1.2ppm and2:3:3. Independently map CH3COOCH2CH3, check mass88 and carbonyl adjacency of acetyl methyl. Source quote supports integration; surrounding transcript supports coupling. n+1 limited to simple first-order equivalent neighboring set, not all nonequivalent hydrogens.
